en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European town square with cobblestone streets and late‑Baroque / Biedermeier townhouses. In the foreground stands a tall Marian column: a statue of the Virgin Mary crowned with stars atop a high pedestal surrounded by several saints. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and gather around the monument. Shop signs in German are visible on the right‑hand buildings.
